pr_title: Add assert.h to threads_pthread.c for NonStop thread compiles.
pr_comments: This PR also applies to Standard Posix Thread (SPT) builds on NonStop.
The single line PR is now ready ;)
May I request that this get merged soon? Our CI pipeline for threads is blocked without it and I would like to test with the current set of merges.
This was approved many days ago we just forgot to set the label. Merging.
Merged. Thank you for the contribution and patience.

issue_context.title: Missing assert on NonStop x86/ia64 PUT build at beta1
issue_context.body:
The Posix User Thread build for NonStop is missing an include to support `assert()`
```

          assert(errno != EDEADLK && errno != EBUSY);
          ^
"/home/ituglib/randall/jenkins/.jenkins/workspace/OpenSSL-3.0_Pipeline/crypto/threads_pthread.c", line 83: error(114):
          identifier "assert" is undefined

          assert(errno != EDEADLK && errno != EBUSY);
          ^
"/home/ituglib/randall/jenkins/.jenkins/workspace/OpenSSL-3.0_Pipeline/crypto/threads_pthread.c", line 98: error(114):

          assert(errno != EPERM);
          ^
"/home/ituglib/randall/jenkins/.jenkins/workspace/OpenSSL-3.0_Pipeline/crypto/threads_pthread.c", line 113: error(114):
          identifier "assert" is undefined
```

comments:
A simple fix would be:
```
diff --git a/crypto/threads_pthread.c b/crypto/threads_pthread.c
index ecb53299c..fee8d50b5 100644
--- a/crypto/threads_pthread.c
+++ b/crypto/threads_pthread.c
@@ -24,6 +24,10 @@
 #  include <unistd.h>
 #endif

+# if defined(OPENSSL_SYS_TANDEM)
+#  include <assert.h>
+# endif
+
 # ifdef PTHREAD_RWLOCK_INITIALIZER
 #  define USE_RWLOCK
 # endif
```

If that is acceptable, I will push it.

review_comments:
Beat me to this one :)

```c
# else
#  include <assert.h>
```

is the other way of doing this.  We're only using assert() on the non _USE_RWLOCK_ paths.
